verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is an API-first banking platform with a public reference: API-key Basic Auth, a sandbox, and documented endpoints for accounts, ACH, wires, book transfers, cards, and full webhook CRUD. It also offers a Postman collection and serves an llms.txt doc index. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
